description.$value: Motion tokens for the Disabled motion mode — all durations set to zero for reduced-motion accessibility.

micro.$description: For hover states, focus rings, and micro-interactions. Reduced motion: instant transition.

smooth.$description: For tooltips, dropdowns, and smooth transitions. Reduced motion: instant transition.

comfortable.$description: For modals, sidebars, and prominent UI changes. Reduced motion: instant transition.

relaxed.$description: For page transitions and major layout shifts. Reduced motion: instant transition.
